## The apps

All the apps used in these pages, each as a folder with `ui.R` and `server.R`:

[Download all the apps (.zip)](../apps.zip){.btn .btn-primary}

| Folder | App |
|---|---|
| `01-basic` | The very first app |
| `02-datasets` | Two outputs, duplicated code |
| `03-reactive` | The same, with `reactive()` |
| `04-eventreactive` | The same, with a button and `eventReactive()` |
| `05-explore-step1` … `step4` | The explore-a-dataset app, step by step |
| `extra-update-input` | `observeEvent()` + `updateSelectInput()` |
| `extra-interactive-plots` | Click and brush on a plot |
| `extra-download` | Download plots and results |

## Learn more

- [Shiny for R](https://shiny.posit.co/r/getstarted/): the official tutorials
- [Shiny components gallery](https://shiny.posit.co/r/components/): all the inputs and outputs, with code
- [Mastering Shiny](https://mastering-shiny.org/), by Hadley Wickham: the reference book, free online
- [Shine with quarto](https://arca-dpss.github.io/shine-with-quarto/): R projects, GitHub and Quarto
